1f802549-d7b1-4470-96cf-46444d156f72.name: data analyst
1f802549-d7b1-4470-96cf-46444d156f72.job_description: We are looking for a Data Analyst Intern to support our team in collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to help drive business decisions. The intern will assist in building dashboards, generating reports, cleaning datasets, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights from operational and recruitment data. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and help optimize processes through data-driven analysis. This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, analytical, and eager to gain hands-on experience with real-world data projects.
1f802549-d7b1-4470-96cf-46444d156f72.notes: We are seeking candidates who are proactive, curious, and passionate about data analytics. Basic knowledge of SQL, spreadsheets, Python, or data visualization tools such as Power BI/Tableau is preferred. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate insights clearly are highly valued. Prior internship, organizational, or academic project experience related to data analysis will be a plus, but candidates with a strong willingness to learn and grow are encouraged to apply.

32254795-ed83-4710-96b5-0dde676a9693.name: Project Manager
32254795-ed83-4710-96b5-0dde676a9693.job_description:
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Information Systems, Informatics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related fields.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Experienced in SQL and database modeling concepts, including designing relational databases and writing optimized queries.
Familiar with data processing and reporting using Excel or Google Sheets, including advanced formulas, filtering, and data integration functions such as IMPORTRANGE.
Able to analyze and interpret datasets to generate meaningful insights and support decision-making processes.
Capable of working with structured and unstructured data while maintaining data accuracy and integrity.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience coordinating between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Able to manage multiple tasks, work independently, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in project coordination, leadership, mentoring, or academic assistance is a plus.
Passionate about data analytics, business intelligence, and continuous learning in technology-driven environments.
